description:
Hi! I’m Albert, a Computer Science and Software Engineering student from Côte d’Ivoire with a strong interest in AI, software, data, and technology for social impact.

I enjoy turning ideas into practical solutions. I have experience with machine learning, data analysis, web and mobile development, and I’ve worked on projects involving healthcare, agriculture, IoT, and digital solutions for local communities. I also enjoy teamwork, problem-solving, and taking initiative when working.
